_doc: Bishop line (spec #372, ticket BS2 #374). The job entry (232, playable since BS10 #382), its AP row, its bot scores and its tool hub kit. Discovered by DataRepo.lines() from this file alone (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4); no shared list names it. Skill keys stay inert until their tickets define them in skills/bishop.json (BS4-BS8); holy_arrow, heal and teleport_cleric live in skills/bishop.json (moved out of skills/magician.json by BS5 #377 and BS4 #376); magic_claw stays F/P's own definition in skills/magician.json. The Holy Symbol (2311003) is the common EXP passive every job takes, not a Bishop entry.

232._starting_skill: tier C: spec #372 D2: every round starts with Holy Arrow in active slot 1.
232._mobility_skill: tier C: spec #372 D1 / R4: Teleport (2301001) is Bishop's manual mobility skill on the skill key, outside both slot tracks; its data moves into this line with BS5.
232._skill_pool: tier C: spec #372: the ten pool actives of the 200/230/231/232 books (Energy Bolt is not in the pool, D2; Holy Symbol is the common passive; Resurrection is a reaction and takes an active slot, D6). Magic Claw is F/P's own definition (one set of data, no copies).
232._weapon_families: tier C: spec #372: the wand and staff families, as F/P and I/L; the Magician armour drops by the class bit.
232._creation_weapon: tier C: spec #372: the same Wooden Wand as F/P and I/L; wearing it needs only the Magician class bit (reqJob, no level requirement).
232._provenance: tier C: spec #372 BS2 #374: playable since BS10 #382 after BS4-BS9 supplied the skills, bot and tooling; F/P (212) stays the default.

hub_kit._fixture: tier C: spec #372 BS9: the Bishop fixture (tier 2, the F/P kit worn); created by BS9, tool-only.
hub_kit._kit: tier C: spec #372: Bishop wears the same wands and staves from the same scroll lines as F/P, so its spare equipment and scroll stacks are F/P's (values duplicated: a kit is read whole, never merged with another job's).

232._ap: tier C: spec #372: INT primary, LUK secondary, the 212 curve (the same as I/L's 222 row).
